text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As autumn arrived, while continuing her 
training with an eye on the approaching 
Classic Class, one day—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend
text_block_list.text: Ah, Vivlos-chan! I saw your UmaTok~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, UmaTok is a popular 
short-form video platform. I hear it's 
quite a hit with the youth.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Kyaa, thank you♡ How was it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Geez, same as always! Super cute and super 
informative!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Even in October, it's still summer in 
Dubai, huh? I had no idea.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos's Friend
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the "Dubai Master"! Can't 
wait for your next update~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainy, you have a total question mark on 
your face~! Well, you see, I'm on UmaTok~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I post whatever I like, like dance clips 
and stuff!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Still, the main topic is Dubai, you know? 
Like the country's vibe, its history, 
trivia, and stuff~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, she's putting out some 
seriously good content. You can really 
tell just how deep her love for Dubai 
runs.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And then, before I knew it, the comments 
started calling me the "Dubai Master"!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I even changed my handle to match! 
"Verxina [Dubai Master]", don't forget to 
follow me! â¡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, changing the subject— Trainy, you 
free on your next day off?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Wanna go cheer on Cheva-chi in her race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheva-chi... Her other older sister, 
Cheval Grand. Right now, she's giving it 
her all in the Classic division.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on our next day off, the two of us 
came to watch the race Cheval Grand was 
running in.

text_block_list.name: Race Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—The winner is Cheval Grand! With a 
2-length lead, an undisputed victory!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaa~! Amazing, amazing! As expected of 
Schval-chi!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Seriously, as expected of you~~! So cool♡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, once we're done, wanna go over to 
Cheval-chi's place? Let's surprise her!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Nihehe! Actually, I haven't told 
Cheval-chi that I came today!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let's say congrats and totally surprise 
them!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...It's fine. ...Please don't say 
anything. Things like celebrations..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh? Cheval-chi?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...The amazing girls of my generation are 
running in GⅠ races. Even Big Sis already 
has, long ago..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, I'm still 'here.' To celebrate 
over something of this level is just..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Still, winning is amazing, you know?! Just 
how amazing you are, Cheval, I—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm telling you, you've got it wrong!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...! Ah... th-that was...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...You want to win the Triple Tiara, 
right? Then... you'd better stop worrying 
about me.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh, why!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I'm just a useless failure who ran away...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I was scared of being compared to Big 
sis... That's why I chose the Classic 
Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even with all that, in the end... I 
couldn't run in the Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Unlike me, you have real talent. 
There's no point in looking down at the 
bottom—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Ah-ah, now I got scolded!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Did I... make them hate me again?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Somehow, Cheval-chi is just so 
complicated.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I feel like... I'm being subtly avoided...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Back when we were little kids, we used to 
be super close friends, though."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I wonder why...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it'll be fine! Because I love 
you so much, Cheval-chi!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I mean, Cheval-chi, you're super cool!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
She said she ran away, but I'm like, 
wasn't that totally not the case?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
To me, it looks like you want to run your 
own path, not the one your sister paved 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I think that must be super tough. Yet 
she's giving it her all without giving up.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Isn't Schwa-chi just super cool like that?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, right~?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, Cheva-chi, everything will be 
totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
After all, you're big sis's little sis, 
and my big sis, too♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos places deep trust not only in 
Verxina, but also in Cheval Grand. Though 
it doesn't seem to be getting across right 
now—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: *cough*.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, totally fine! Is the air a bit 
dry? Must be autumn~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, when I went to the 
amusement park with Verxina before, she 
complained of a slight stomachache. 
Nothing came of it afterward, but...
choice_data_list:
Let's head to the infirmary when we get 
back, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, in that case, I'll be fine on my own. 
I'll go on ahead!"
choice_data_list: Alright, report back to me later.

Alright, be sure to report back to me 
later.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll go check out the kiosk for a 
bit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She'll be in the Classic Class soon. To 
ensure she can fulfill her dreams to her 
heart's content... I should keep a close 
eye on her condition once more.
